notes: Sandbox egress restrictions: general web-search engines were unusable (Bing served poisoned/irrelevant results; DuckDuckGo, Mojeek unreachable), so discovery was done by navigating reachable sites (nclex.com, careers360.com, getmyuni.com, pw.live, pharmatutor.org, magoosh.com, en.wikipedia.org API) and following links actually seen on fetched pages. Every topic line below comes from a page listed in that exam's 'sources'.

Official sites unreachable from this sandbox: natboard.edu.in (NBEMS, HTTP 403), indianursingcouncil.org (INC), vciindia.in (VCI), dcindia.gov.in (DCI), nta.ac.in (NTA), aamc.org (AAMC, HTTP 403). Reputable medical-education mirrors were used for those exams, as permitted by the brief.

NCLEX-RN is the only exam sourced OFFICIALLY: client-need categories, subcategories and content lines were extracted from the NCSBN '2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan' PDF hosted on nclex.com (the current test-plan vintage, reviewed/approved every three years; supersedes the 2023 plan).

FMGE: subject set and unit names from Careers360's mirror of the NBEMS FMGE/FMGQE syllabus (Anatomy through Community Medicine, ~312 named units). Unit-level detail was compressed to subject lines plus key sub-topic lines for Medicine, per the agreed granularity; Anesthesia/Orthopedics/Radiodiagnosis/Radiotherapy are kept as separate lines since they are the syllabus' named Surgery-cluster subjects.

NEET PG: pre-clinical/para-clinical/clinical subject-wise structure, integrated subject qualifiers (Medicine incl. Dermatology/Venereology/Psychiatry; Surgery incl. Orthopedics/Anesthesia/Radiodiagnosis) and topic lines from PW's (pw.live) NEET PG 2026 syllabus mirror; NBEMS official page unreachable.
GPAT: 19 subject sections from Careers360's mirror of the NBEMS GPAT syllabus (the article explicitly states NBEMS prepares the GPAT syllabus).

INC BSc Nursing: official INC portal unreachable; 8-semester subject structure from a GetMyUni mirror of the INC B.Sc Nursing 2020 Regulations curriculum. Mirror wording may compress official subject titles; non-clinical/general subjects in the mirror list (English, Introduction to Computers, Psychology, Sociology) and obvious filler (Library, Self-Study, Viva) were omitted to keep this medical-sciences ledger focused and within the line budget.

VCI BVSc & AH: official VCI portal unreachable; 9-semester subject list from a GetMyUni mirror of the MSVE-2016-era BVSc & AH curriculum, consolidated to subject level (detailed semester course titles like 'Veterinary Gross Anatomy I/II' merged).

DCI BDS: official DCI portal unreachable; year-wise subject set from Careers360's BDS course page (DCI BDS Course Regulations subject names), deduplicated across years (several subjects appear in both 3rd and 4th year in the mirror).

MCAT: AAMC official site blocked (403); section structure and the four Scientific Inquiry & Reasoning Skills from the Wikipedia article (tertiary mirror). The 10 foundational concepts' lettered content categories (e.g., 1A-10D) could NOT be fetched from any reachable source and are deliberately left unlisted rather than guessed - flagged as the main unverified gap.
Fetch discipline: at most ~2 syllabus-page fetches per exam after navigation pages; saved pages were re-parsed locally instead of re-fetching the same URL.
